Manual checks and environments:

## Privacy, provenance, and rights

- [ ] This pull request contains no real family, household, personal,
      confidential, identifying, or private data in code, fixtures, tests,
      screenshots, recordings, logs, commit messages, or linked artifacts.
- [ ] All examples and media are synthetic and non-identifying.
- [ ] New fixtures and dependencies have documented origin, integrity, and
      license information.
- [ ] Narrator testimony, uncertainty, exact source spans, corrections, and
      conflicting accounts remain attributable where relevant.
- [ ] Privacy, consent, deletion, portability, and degraded-state implications
      are documented where relevant.

## Documentation and review

- [ ] Behavior, limitations, architecture, and verification documentation are
      updated where needed.
- [ ] This is not a public disclosure of a security vulnerability. Suspected
      vulnerabilities were reported through GitHub Security Advisories.
